channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alvin Gentry | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alvin Gentry from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Monte McNair on Alvin Gentry
item.description:
Kings GMMonte McNair on relieving Alvin Gentry of his head coaching duties:

“The entire Kings organization is grateful for the leadership of Alvin Gentry, who stepped up when he got the call mid-season. We appreciate his leadership on and off the court.”

Monte McNair on Alvin Gentry, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @SeanCunningham.

item.title: JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart
item.description:
Redick:

“In my little circle of T.J. McConnell, Doug McDermott, Tobias Harris and Josh Hart, it was usually me. But Josh has got some great Bordeaux in his collection. But he also had some shipped in. The last night I was there, I didn’t have enough room in my luggage to transport all of the wine back home to New York. So I brought six or seven bottles to the Grand Floridian hotel. I had a little wine meal with Timothé Luwawu-Cabarrot, Russell Westbrook, Doug, TJ and myself. Then (former Pelicans coach) Alvin Gentry and (Orlando Magic general manager) John Hammond happened to be sitting at the table next to us. So I shared a couple of sips with them.”

JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart, Sep 21, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: David Griffin on Alvin Gentry, Zion Williamson
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:David Griffin on how he and Alvin Gentry connected with Williamson & his family on the night of the draft lottery:

“We were so taken by Zion in the first 20 minutes that we asked for his family to join us and we spent an hour and a half.”

David Griffin on Alvin Gentry, Zion Williamson, Jun 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: Mickey Loomis on Dell Demps, Alvin Gentry
item.description:
The following is a statement from New Orleans Pelicans Owner Tom Benson and Executive Vice President of Basketball Operations Mickey Loomis:

“After careful and thorough review of basketball operations,we have made the determination that the best course of action as we move forward into the 2017-18 season is to continue under the leadership of General Manager Dell Demps and Head Coach Alvin Gentry.”

Mickey Loomis on Dell Demps, Alvin Gentry, May 15, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dell Demps on Alvin Gentry
item.description:
Brett Dawson:Dell Demps on Alvin Gentry:

“We talk about all decisions that are made, and I really believe that we're tired at the hip and we're in this together.”

Dell Demps on Alvin Gentry, Mar 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @BDawsonWrites.

item.title: Quincy Pondexter on Alvin Gentry
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Quincy Pondexter on Gentry:

“He’s so hip to a lot of things that are new. He probably listens to Drake more than us (Pelicans players).”

Quincy Pondexter on Alvin Gentry, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Alvin Gentry
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Eric Gordon on @blackbluereport about Alvin Gentry:

“I would expect to be one of the best teams, if not the best scoring team in the NBA.”

Eric Gordon on Alvin Gentry, Jun 22, 2015. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Alvin Gentry
item.description:
“We’re going to start playing fast under Alvin Gentry and that should be an easy transition for me. I’ve not heard anything but good things about him,”

Eric Gordon on Alvin Gentry, Jun 11, 2015. Source: Vigilant Sports.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Alvin Gentry, Lindsey Hunter
item.description:
Goran Dragic:

“We all loved playing for coach Alvin Gentry. He didn't fulfill the club's expectations although all of us players wanted him to stay in charge! He still ended up being fired. Lindsey Hunter became the new head coach, but he didnt have any coaching experience prior.”

Goran Dragic on Alvin Gentry, Lindsey Hunter, May 22, 2013. Source: Kosarka.si.
